dct_title_s: Morocco Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Feb 2026
dct_description_sm: # Morocco Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Feb 2026 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Morocco Floods (Feb 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8 ** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025-2026)
